summary: PiP now resizes from ALL FOUR corners (v10 item 3, PLAN.md §3). Changed exactly the three owned files. (1) src/components/viewer3d/SectionPiP.tsx: new exported corner API — `PipCorner`/`PipEdge`, `PIP_CORNER_ORDER = ['se','nw','ne','sw']` (south-east FIRST so `document.querySelector('.pip-panel .pip-resizer')` still resolves to the handle audit.mjs:661/671/2415 focuses, and so the first handle keeps the BARE `class="pip-resizer"` the v9 assertion matches), `PIP_CORNER_EDGES` (which two edges each corner moves / the opposite corner's two it pins), `PIP_CORNER_LABELS`, `pipsizeFromCornerDrag(corner, start, dx, dy)` (E corners own the right edge, S corners the bottom edge — the plan's exact formula, passing the unclamped sum through the STORE's own `clampSectionPipSize`, so 224×170…880×640 can never be bypassed), `pipResizerLabel`/`pipResizerTitle`. The drag state now carries the corner; `onResizePointerMove` calls `pipsizeFromCornerDrag(drag.corner, {baseline box measured from windowRef}, clientX−startX, clientY−startY)`. The four handles are rendered from `PIP_CORNER_ORDER.map` with `data-pip-corner`, one accessible name each ('Resize the simulated-section panel from its north-west corner (224×170 px, 224–880 wide, 170–640 tall)'), four glyphs, and ONE shared arrow-key handler (Arrow keys ±16 px, Shift ×4) whose ABSOLUTE `size + delta` arithmetic and the `▴/▾` cycle, `neuroaxis.sectionPipSize` persistence and the `.pip-panel/.pip-readout/.pip-orient/X-Y-Z/.pip-window-after-.viewer3d-canvas` DOM contract are untouched. (2) src/styles/sectionPip.css: `.pip-resizer` is now the shared 24×24 px absolutely-positioned hit target (touch-action:none) with four corner anchors — `.pip-resizer--nw` (top/left, nwse-resize), `.pip-resizer--ne` (top/right, nesw-resize), `.pip-resizer--sw` (bottom/left, nesw-resize), and the south-east anchor grouped as `.pip-resizer, .pip-resizer--se` (right/bottom, nwse-resize); the base rule is written first so each corner's own cursor wins at equal specificity; `:focus-visible` kept. The two bottom-left text lines moved out of the 24 px handle band (`.pip-offnote` bottom 20→48 px, `.pip-imagery-state` 4→26 px) so the new south-west handle cannot be painted over their first characters. (3) scripts/verify/pip-contract.mjs: NEW §F (104 new assertions) — F1 four handles with four distinct names each naming its corner + live size + built by the shipped label function, first handle bare-classed and south-east; F2 the corner table and render order; F3 the plan's exact numbers (+40/+40 → nw 360×260, ne 440×260, sw 360×340, se 440×340; −400/−400 → nw 800×640, ne 224×640, sw 800×170, se 224×170; +5000/+5000 → exactly the bounds; one-axis drags leave the other axis bit-identical; NaN/∞ stay inside the window) plus an independent re-derivation of the rule; F4 THE GEOMETRY — in a local frame (0,0)–(400,300) the dragged corner lands exactly on pointer+(40,40) (nw→(40,40), ne→(440,40), sw→(40,340), se→(440,340)) while the OPPOSITE corner keeps both coordinates bit-identical (nw fixes (400,300), ne (0,300), sw (400,0), se (0,0)), the pinned edges keep their coordinates, a horizontal-only drag moves neither top nor bottom and a vertical-only drag moves neither left nor right, and at the clamp bound the opposite corner is still fixed; F5 wiring/keyboard non-regression (the shipped function is called, the old `width: drag.width + Δx` formula is gone, the keyboard path is still absolute `size + delta`, one shared handler); F6 stylesheet (four anchors at their own corners, exactly the two diagonal cursors, the 24 px hit target, focus ring, the re-stacked bottom-left lines); F7 the surrounding DOM-order contract (panel after `.viewer3d-canvas`, `.pip-window` inside `.pip-panel`, handles inside `.pip-window`, `windowRef` still passed). Every existing assertion was kept — none deleted or weakened. VERIFIED: `npm run check` exit 0; `npm run verify:pip-contract` exit 0 with 187 passed · 0 failed (was 83/0 before); `npm run build` exit 0 (vite, 11.35 s); also green: validate (0 errors/0 warnings), verify:pipeline, verify:plane (10 827 assertions), verify:somatotopy (45/45), verify:audit-checks (92/0), verify:closure-bite (exit 0), verify:boundary-contract (22/22), verify:a11y-contract (38/38), verify:budget-report (5/0), verify-imaging-v4, verify-imaging-v4b. BITE PROOF (PLAN §7): in an isolated copy (.dsh-scratch/v10-pip-bite, logs kept, sources then removed) six mutations were each run against the gate — baseline 187/0 exit 0; flipped width-sign rule → exit 1 with 24 failures (e.g. 'nw: the DRAGGED corner follows the pointer — (0, 0) + (40, 40) = (-40, 40)'); only three handles rendered → exit 1, 7 failures ('the panel renders exactly 4 corner handles (found 3)'); wrong NE cursor → exit 1, 1 failure; keyboard back to a delta → exit 1, 1 failure; handle names not naming their corner → exit 1, 5 failures; SW anchor moved to bottom:40px → exit 1, 1 failure; restored copy 187/0 exit 0. DEVIATIONS/NOTES (as required): (a) the plan asks for `pip-resizer--nw|ne|sw|se` classes on all four buttons, but it also requires the FIRST handle to keep the literal `class="pip-resizer"` (the v9 substring assertion) — the two are mutually exclusive on one element, so the three other handles carry their modifier and the south-east anchor is grouped with the base selector in CSS (live via `.pip-resizer`, documented in both files); (b) no package.json edit and NO new npm script is needed — `verify:pip-contract` already exists and was only updated; (c) HONEST LIMIT: the panel is docked bottom-right and no task in this run owns a panel-position field, so 'the opposite corner stays fixed' is asserted as the geometry the panel implements (asserted in §F4), not as a screen-space invariant — on screen a grown window extends left/up because the dock pins right/bottom; (d) task 5 (review-qa) must re-point audit.mjs:523-525 from `resizer === 1` to 4 (per PLAN §6) or the browser lane will report one handle where there are four; (e) `npm run verify:cortical-lobes` is currently RED (4 synthetic failures) from the parallel cortical-divisions-quality task mid-edit — its gate reads none of my files (grep-verified, and my three files are the only ones I modified); verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit are RED at base for the recorded sandbox reason. NOT OBSERVED HERE (Chrome cannot start in this sandbox; orchestrator-only): that a real pointer drag on each of the four handles moves the box on screen and that the dock-pinned edge does not move, that arrow keys move it by 16 px (Shift ×4) in a live page, and that the size survives a real reload.
